purpose: One independent process exact same-ELF replay of the first admitted notified ReleaseSafe short recording. No rebuild, re-record, hooks or reference injection.

parameters.TAPE_DIRECTORY: Original recorded directory containing immutable bank.bin/history.bin

bounds.timeout: TERM process group, 10 second grace then KILL. A timeout does not prove native cleanup.

prechecks: Archive record result first. Verify exact source tree/clean worktree, ELF and both input file hashes.
Verify16 authored fixtures before and after within60 seconds each. No extraSME variables.
required: Strict preflight admitted before owners, requested pacing matching canonical launch.
Actual concurrent native owners, real source decoding/clocks and output comparisons.
Exact full PCM, canonical Input/Schedule, command/UI outcomes, role EOF and actual Host joined/destroyed.
Both Play and Stop accepted/executed and exact2 terminal outcomes; nonzero realPCM witness.
Report actual result/cleanup and unchanged source and bank/history hashes; do not infer cleanup from exit alone.
stop: Single attempt; preserve mismatch/rejection/timeout with original tape unchanged. No re-record or timing retry. Unknown remains UNKNOWN.
limits: Short minimum loop only, not original long>=32768 qualification.
Debug recording overflow remains unresolved regardless of replay outcome.
No Windows or physical devices; no binary/raw uploads; main unchanged.
